market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver reaching $120 by June 2026 would require more than tripling its all-time high (~$50) in under 1.5 years from current ~$30 level. This would demand an extraordinary macro shock (e.g., hyperinflation) or a speculative mania far exceeding historical extremes, making the true probability far below 1%.
evidence_points: Silver all-time high is near $50 (1980, 2011); $120 is 2.4x that peak.
Current silver price ~$30-35, implying a 4x move in ~1.5 years with no clear fundamental catalyst.
Implied probability of 6.7% vastly overstates the likelihood compared to historical asset price moves over similar horizons.
sources_consulted: CME Group silver futures historical settlement data
General knowledge of precious metals markets and volatility
